M2.L1.title: Express metric length measurements in terms of a smaller unit; model and solve addition and subtraction word problems involving metric length.

M2.L2.title: Express metric mass measurements in terms of a smaller unit; model and solve addition and subtraction word problems involving metric mass.

M2.L3.title: Express metric capacity measurements in terms of a smaller unit; model and solve addition and subtraction word problems involving metric capacity.

M2.L4.title: Know and relate metric units to place value units in order to express measurements in different units.

M2.L5.title: Use addition and subtraction to solve multi-step word problems involving length, mass, and capacity.
